The report now documents twenty-five reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F25: failed transaction-log truncation clears the in-memory database before returning `false`**. [ZKDatabase.truncateLog](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/ZKDatabase.java:611) calls `clear()` before attempting the log truncation. With a valid snapshot but no log file, truncation returned `false` and left the data tree empty:

```
node before failed truncate: true
truncate result: false
node after failed truncate: false
AssertionError: failed truncate cleared the in-memory database
```
